candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory dependency, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, which surfaces as 502s at the gateway /v1/checkout route.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show redis timeouts but no redis-side metrics/logs; root cause within redis (load, saturation, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and ReadTimeout on order, yielding 502s at gateway /v1/checkout. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics (latency, connections, saturation) to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs correlating the redis DependencyUnavailable errors
Excluded gateway logs (ev-ac7ce1c5453750e5-r0-gw-logs) to corroborate the 502 path
